knownIssues.heading: Known Issues — v1.2.0 Firmware
knownIssues.intro: Firmware defects accepted as expected-fail (XFAIL) until a fix releases and the test unexpectedly passes (XPASS). Each row maps to the DVT step and/or the HIL Test Report (Section D) that tracks it.

externalRefs.title: Main Board DVT
externalRefs.intro: Board-level qualification of the bare mainboard, owned by the external Main Board DVT and not repeated here. This package begins at the assembled-controller boundary. The Main Board DVT owns: RS-485 dual ports (FC-CM-2), analog-input impedance (~100 kΩ) and 40 VDC over-range tolerance (referenced from [biz.1.1]), and alarm-relay fail-open on loss of controller power (referenced from [biz.2.5]).
externalRefs.passCriteria: Signed Main Board DVT on record for the mainboard serial number installed in this assembly. Signed copy attached to this run as an artifact. Section B does not begin until the Section A artifact is present.

externalRefs.title: MIB DVT
externalRefs.intro: PCB-level qualification of each Motor Interface Board, owned by the external MIB DVT. Bare-board electrical functional, AOI, and SPI-side testing are owned by that document and not repeated here.
externalRefs.passCriteria: Signed MIB DVT on record for every MIB serial number installed in this assembly. Signed copies attached to this run as artifacts. Section C does not begin until all MIB DVT artifacts are present.

externalRefs.title: FCAT Test Report
externalRefs.intro: Production + assembly and functional verification by the FCAT bench (Fan Controller Automated Tester). Provides the signed evidence for the FCAT-run cases: airflow measurement accuracy and analog output [biz.2.1], motor fault status [biz.2.2], and status reporting [biz.2.5].
externalRefs.passCriteria: Signed FCAT Test Report attached to this run as an artifact. Section D does not begin until the FCAT report is present.

externalRefs.title: HIL Test Report
externalRefs.intro: Hardware-in-the-loop automated verification of ALL Modbus and BACnet functions, attached as signed evidence. Covers: Modbus RTU point-list read/write, configurable + persistent Server ID, Writing-Key write protection, invalid / out-of-range request handling (FC-CM-1, FC-CM-3, FC-CM-5, FC-CM-8); BACnet/IP object reads/writes, COV subscription, and concurrent-with-Modbus operation; BACnet MS/TP where the firmware ships it. The HIL bench also hosts the HIL-run cases referenced from Sections E and G. Full coverage list in [hil] detail, Appendix C.
externalRefs.passCriteria: Signed HIL Test Report attached to this run as an artifact. Zero unexpected FAILs; every XFAIL / XPASS reconciled against the firmware Known Issues table. Sections E–I do not begin until the HIL report is present.

appendixA.heading: Appendix A — Equipment and HIL Bill of Materials
appendixA.intro: Test equipment and station fixtures referenced from the cases, plus the discrete-module bill of materials to build the HIL station. Prices captured June 2026 — re-check before purchase. The 24 VDC/VAC supply, the >40 VDC overvoltage source, and the FLA multimeter are operator-provided bench equipment.

appendixB.heading: Appendix B — DVT Change Triggers
appendixB.intro: Each test runs when any of its change triggers occurs. A first build (FTE) requires every test. Triggers for the low-voltage-supply split (E.1, E.2, E.3) are provisional, carried over from the original combined case, and will be revisited in the regression review.

appendixC.heading: Appendix C — Case Detail, Station Capabilities, and Traceability
appendixC.intro: Full objective / equipment / setup / procedure / acceptance for each case (the compact table rows are summaries), the evidence-report coverage lists, the capability each station must have, a reference crosswalk to the source package, and traceability notes. Indexed by reference.

sections.name: Electrical
sections.intro: Low-voltage supply operation, full-load current, overvoltage protection, protective earthing, and power-cycle / brownout robustness. Stations: HIL, manual bench, FCMT. Verifies FC-EL-5, FC-EL-15, FC-EL-6, plus the V3.2.0 post-mortem power-cycle characterization (E.5; rationale in [elec.5]).

sections.name: Analog Voltage Testing (CN1, CN2)
sections.intro: Analog voltage characterization on the CN1/CN2 signal connectors: AI1 input, A1_OUTPUT, DI thresholds, DO levels, K1 alarm relay, plus out-of-bounds voltage stress and propagation-time captures via scope + logic analyzer. Protocol functions (Modbus/BACnet) are evidenced by the HIL Test Report [hil]; application behavior is in Business Logic [biz].

sections.name: Business Logic
sections.intro: Application and firmware/control behavioral verification: speed-command source selection and passthrough, airflow measurement and analog output, motor fault status, active-vs-supported motor count with blank-off, configuration persistence, status reporting, speed-modulation variants, and start/stop digital input. Exercises control logic via Modbus/BACnet (evidenced by HIL Test Report [hil]) and at FCAT (FCAT Test Report [fcat]). Verifies FC-SI-1, FC-SI-2, FC-SI-4, FC-SI-5, FC-FW-2, FC-FW-3, FC-FW-4, FC-FW-5, FC-FW-7, FC-FW-8.

sections.name: Analysis & Regulatory
sections.intro: Engineering-analysis cases (no test station). Impeller power compatibility and EMC immunity. Verifies FC-EL-1, FC-RE-5, FC-RE-6.

sections.name: Demonstration, Inspection & Production
sections.intro: Removable-cover demonstration, the design-verification inspection checklist, and production-record / production-test items. Station: Inspection & Mechanical (demonstration + checklist); production line (records/test).

steps.brief: HIL. Power controller from 24 VDC, then from 24 VAC; run the power-supply verification on each. Detail: [elec.1].
steps.criteria: Verification passes on BOTH the 24 VDC and the 24 VAC supply. (FC-EL-5.)

steps.brief: Manual bench. Measure low-voltage input current at full load with a bench DMM.
steps.criteria: Measured FLA ≤ 500 mA. (FC-EL-5.)

steps.brief: Manual + HIL. Raise input >40 VDC, confirm OVP activates; return to normal, confirm auto-reset; run HIL capability check. Detail: [elec.3].
steps.criteria: OVP activates above 40 VDC; auto-resets on return to normal; controller passes post-event verification. (FC-EL-15.)

steps.brief: FCMT. 4-wire measure bonding resistance: PE terminal to enclosure and to each accessible exposed conductive part.
steps.criteria: All measured bonding resistances ≤ 0.1 Ω. (FC-EL-6.)

steps.brief: HIL. At nominal CN3, read 3.3 / 12 / 24 V rails on DMM + console; compare on-board rail monitors to DMM. Rationale: [elec.5].
steps.criteria: Rails within spec; each on-board monitor within ±2% of DMM; idle current ≤ spec.

steps.brief: HIL + programmable supply. Sweep CN3 22–26 VAC and 22–26 VDC in 1 V steps, 30 s dwell; log rails.
steps.criteria: Rails within spec; no trip, brownout, or comm drop across the sweep.

steps.brief: HIL + programmable supply. Ramp CN3 down to the brownout threshold and up to 30 V; log rails, Modbus, console.
steps.criteria: Rails track per spec until threshold; clean reset below; no rail damage or garbled frames above; clean recovery to nominal.

steps.brief: HIL. CN3 OFF→ON; poll Modbus identity at 100 ms and BACnet Who-Is at 500 ms; record time to first valid response.
steps.criteria: First valid Modbus ≤ boot spec; first I-Am ≤ stack-init spec; no spurious pre-boot responses; identity correct.

steps.brief: HIL + programmable supply. Active Modbus polling; sag CN3 24→22 V for 100 ms, return; repeat 50×.
steps.criteria: Zero resets; zero garbled frames; all 50 ride-throughs clean; rails stable post-dip.

steps.brief: HIL + programmable supply. Active polling; sag CN3 to 16 V for 500 ms; recover.
steps.criteria: Clean reset on dip; no data corruption; EEPROM scratch intact post-recovery; boot banner clean.

steps.brief: HIL + programmable supply. Sweep sag depth at 100 ms: 23, 22, 21, 20, 19, 18, 17 V; identify the ride-through floor. Rationale: [elec.5].
steps.criteria: Ride-through / reset boundary repeatable ±0.5 V over 5 runs; matches firmware spec.

steps.brief: HIL + scope. Scope 3.3 / 5 / 12 / 24 V rails + MCU NRST; CN3 OFF; record collapse times idle and under 1 s Modbus load.
steps.criteria: Reset asserts before any rail drops below the MCU brownout threshold; loaded times ≥ idle by a non-zero margin; all times recorded.

steps.brief: HIL power-cycle relay. 50-cycle sweeps at varied OFF-dwell (full rail collapse down to minimal discharge); verify boot banner, identity read, and atmospheric PT each cycle. Rationale: [elec.5].
steps.criteria: All cycles boot clean; PT atmospheric at start of each; zero identity / PT errors across all dwell lengths.

steps.brief: HIL. Master polls at 1 s through 20 brownout-window cycles; verify clean disconnect/reconnect.
steps.criteria: Clean disconnect/reconnect each cycle; zero garbled frames within ±2 s of transition; zero stale-data accepts.

steps.brief: HIL. Write a known value to EEPROM; power-cycle; re-read. 100 cycles.
steps.criteria: Zero bit errors over 100 power cycles.

steps.brief: Drive AI1 with calibrated 5.00 V ±1%; read firmware value.
steps.criteria: 5.00 V ±2% mirrored on Fan Speed frame harness connector.

steps.brief: Drive AI1 with 3 random voltages in 1–10 V at 1% precision.
steps.criteria: All 3 mirrored on Fan Speed frame harness connector within ±2% applied.

steps.brief: Drive AI1 shorted to AI1− and disconnected; record reported.
steps.criteria: Both: 0.00 V @ Fan Speed frame harness connector, ±2% FS.

steps.brief: Drive AI1 above 10 V and below 0 V, observing the resulting speed-modulation output. Detail: [analog.1.4].
steps.criteria: Output clamps at 0 V and 10 V.

steps.brief: Measure A1_OUTPUT when airflow is at 25%, 50%, 75% and 100% of fan capability.
steps.criteria: All within ±4% commanded (2.5 V, 5 V, 7.5 V, 10 V).

steps.brief: Sweep DI1 0.0–24 V in 0.05 V steps; record transition.
steps.criteria: LOW ≥ 0.33 V; HIGH ≤ 0.25 V; hysteresis in spec.

steps.brief: In AI1 bypass mode, short DI1+ and DI1- to each other.
steps.criteria: Voltage applied to AI1 is mirrored on Fan Speed frame harness connector.

steps.brief: In AI1 bypass mode, disconnect DI1+ and DI1-.
steps.criteria: Voltage applied to AI1 is NOT mirrored on Fan Speed frame harness connector.

steps.brief: In AI1 bypass mode, short DI1+ and DI1- to GND.
steps.criteria: Voltage applied to AI1 is mirrored on Fan Speed frame harness connector.

steps.brief: In AI1 bypass mode, short DI1+ and DI1- to 24V.
steps.criteria: Voltage applied to AI1 is mirrored on Fan Speed frame harness connector.

steps.brief: Cycle K1 50× via console; DMM K1A/K1B/K1C.
steps.criteria: 50 cycles transfer correctly; no misses; bounce in debounce window.

steps.brief: Command A1_OUTPUT below 0 V and above max via Modbus; verify firmware clamps command, no damage. Detail: [analog.1.4].
steps.criteria: Commanded output clamps at documented limits; no DAC fault; recovery to commanded value clean.

steps.brief: Inject 100 mV pk-pk noise on each DI line at 1 kHz; logic analyzer captures transitions.
steps.criteria: Zero false transitions over 60 s; firmware DI state stable.

steps.brief: Load each DO with rated load and 1.5× rated load (resistive); measure drive integrity.
steps.criteria: HIGH/LOW levels within spec at both loads; no thermal warning; recovery clean after stress.

steps.brief: Cycle K1 50× under representative alarm load; measure contact resistance and arc dwell.
steps.criteria: Resistance < spec each cycle; bounce in debounce window.

steps.brief: Scope Speed Modulation output after a Modbus write completes (CRC ACK on bus); measure command-to-output latency. Detail: [analog.7].
steps.criteria: Latency ≤ documented Modbus → DAC update spec; no glitch on AO1 during transition.

steps.brief: Scope K1A/K1B contacts after plug fan fault; measure firmware-to-mechanical timing.
steps.criteria: Driver assertion ≤ firmware spec; K1 transfer time ≤ relay spec; no chatter.

steps.brief: Scope SPI MISO at MIB position 1 and position N; LA captures CS; measure clock-to-data delay across daisy chain.
steps.criteria: Setup/hold met at every position; aggregate propagation ≤ spec for configured N.

steps.brief: HIL. A1 Output Mode = Analog: apply known voltages to analog input, verify every motor output matches. Mode = Modbus: command known output voltages, verify every motor output matches. Detail: [biz.1.1].
steps.criteria: Motor output voltages match expected in all cases, both modes. (FC-SI-1, FC-SI-4, FC-FW-7.)

steps.brief: HIL. De-energize controller logic (motor power retained); apply and vary analog speed input; measure at motor positions.
steps.criteria: De-energized, analog speed input reaches motor positions and motor response tracks the input. (FC-SI-5.)

steps.brief: FCAT. Airflow-accuracy routine at 25% of each impeller max; airflow-output routine across range vs FCAT reference. Worst-case fan model. Detail: [biz.2.1]. Evidence: [fcat].
steps.criteria: |error| ≤ 3% of reading at the 25% point each channel; 0–10 V airflow output linear within ±5% full range. (FC-FW-2, FC-SI-2.)

steps.brief: FCAT. Fault-determination routine: induce per-position fault, read per-motor + aggregate status, clear, confirm both reset. Evidence: [fcat].
steps.criteria: Faulted position flagged; aggregate status active; both reset on clear. (FC-FW-3.)

steps.brief: HIL. Blank off a position; confirm no fault when unpopulated; confirm excluded from airflow count; confirm active count reflects connected non-blanked motors.
steps.criteria: Blanked position suppressed from alarms and from the airflow count; active motor count correct. (FC-FW-4.)

steps.brief: HIL. Set each persisted parameter (controlled list) to a non-default value; power-cycle; read back.
steps.criteria: Every configuration parameter in the referenced document retains its value after the power cycle. (FC-FW-5.)

steps.brief: FCAT (partial). Confirm alarm relay closed when healthy; induce a motor fault; confirm relay opens and Modbus reflects individual + aggregate status. Detail: [biz.2.5]. Evidence: [fcat].
steps.criteria: Relay closed when healthy, opens on fault; Modbus reflects individual + aggregate status. Relay fail-open on loss of power → [mainboard_dvt]. (FC-FW-8.)

steps.brief: Command fan-enable ON/OFF 50× via Modbus coil; verify MOTOR STATUS and MIB drive line track. Basic line-drive sanity at FCAT [fcat].
steps.criteria: All 50 cycles assert correctly; drive line within [analog.6.2] levels; MOTOR STATUS reflects each transition.

steps.brief: Assert blank-off coil per motor; verify Fan Motor n Blank-Off DI updates and MOTOR_COUNT_ENABLED decrements.
steps.criteria: Coil → DI mirror bit-for-bit; MOTOR_COUNT_ENABLED reflects per-fan blank-off.

steps.brief: With blank-off coil ON for motor 1, disconnect motor 1; verify alarm does NOT raise. Known issue — blank-off does not currently suppress alarm. Detail: [biz.3.3].
steps.criteria: PASS = no alarm on blanked-motor disconnect. XFAIL on v1.2.0 per Known Issues. XPASS = fix landed.

steps.brief: Cycle Control Source through AI1 / Modbus % / Modbus voltage / BACnet (fw 1.4.0+) / airflow setpoint; verify AO1 tracks each mode's command.
steps.criteria: AO1 follows commanded source within ±4% in each mode; transition glitch ≤ documented spec.

steps.brief: Scope AO1 during a 0→10 V step command in each speed-mod mode; measure slew and overshoot.
steps.criteria: Slew within firmware spec; overshoot ≤ 5%; no oscillation.

steps.header: Speed-mod with airflow feedback (XFAIL — not shipped)
steps.brief: With airflow-setpoint mode active, vary AIRFLOW_OUTPUT reading; verify closed-loop AO1 response.
steps.criteria: AO1 converges to setpoint; loop stable; no hunting. XFAIL until shipped.

steps.brief: Assert documented Start/Stop DI; verify RUN_STATUS transitions and motors stop/start. Not implemented in v1.2.0. Detail: [biz.5.1].
steps.criteria: XFAIL accepted on v1.2.0 per Known Issues. XPASS = start/stop DI feature shipped; reconcile against backlog.

steps.brief: Analysis. Analyze worst-case configs (max voltage: 575 VAC at max qty; max aggregate current) vs controller input-current capacity and component ratings. Detail: [anlz.1].
steps.criteria: Both worst-case configs within controller capacity and component ratings; compatibility-list per-model limits consistent. (FC-EL-1.)

steps.brief: Analysis. Assess design (protection devices, layout, grounding) against IEC 61000-4-2 immunity levels; document with supporting component ratings.
steps.criteria: Documented assessment shows the design meets IEC 61000-4-2 immunity levels. (FC-RE-5.)

steps.brief: Analysis. Assess design (surge protection on power and signal lines) against IEC 61000-4-5 immunity levels; document with supporting component ratings.
steps.criteria: Documented assessment shows the design meets IEC 61000-4-5 immunity levels. (FC-RE-6.)

steps.brief: Demonstration. Remove front cover per the User Manual; confirm access to fuses and terminal blocks; reinstall per procedure.
steps.criteria: Cover removed and reinstalled without removing the enclosure; access achieved. (FC-PH-2.)

steps.criteria: Conforms to UL 60335-2-40 (Ed. 4, 2022). (FC-RE-1.)

elaborations.text: Board-level qualification of the bare mainboard (HiPot, ICT, AOI, electrical functional at the board boundary) owned by the external Main Board DVT and not repeated here. Section A is a reference plus a sign-off attestation that the mainboard SN in this assembly has a signed Main Board DVT on record. Items owned by that document and referenced here: RS-485 dual ports (FC-CM-2); analog-input impedance (~100 kΩ) and 40 VDC over-range tolerance (from G.1.1); alarm-relay fail-open on loss of controller power (from G.2.5).

PCB-level qualification of each MIB board owned by the external MIB DVT. Section B is a reference and attestation page: for every MIB position in the assembly, a signed MIB DVT must be attached. SPI-side propagation as installed in the assembly is exercised at F.7.3; bare-board MIB coverage is owned by Section B.

The FCAT bench (NI LabVIEW + SCPI, own pressure/airflow reference, mainboard + MIB-slot fixture) runs production + assembly and functional verification on every assembled controller. The signed FCAT Test Report is the evidence for the FCAT-run cases G.2.1 (airflow accuracy & output), G.2.2 (motor fault status), and G.2.5 (status reporting). Attach the signed report before Section D.

elaborations.ref: Section D — HIL Test Report (external evidence)
elaborations.text: Hardware-in-the-loop automated suite, signed report attached as evidence. Modbus coverage: read every point-list object (types/addresses match the controlled document); write each writable object; change Server ID via holding register, power-cycle, confirm changed and persisted; reject protected-register write without the Writing Key and accept with it; inject out-of-range register and invalid/unsupported function requests, confirm the proper protocol error each time with motor control uninterrupted; high-rate polling and malformed-frame stress; sustained-poll soak. Verifies FC-CM-1, FC-CM-3, FC-CM-5, FC-CM-8. BACnet/IP coverage: Who-Is/I-Am discovery; object reads (AI, AV, BI, BV, MI/MO/MV); writes (AO with Control Source = BACnet); COV subscription; concurrent BACnet/IP + Modbus operation. BACnet MS/TP coverage where the firmware ships the stack. On Rev 3 v1.2.0, BACnet/IP is Who-Is/I-Am only and MS/TP is absent — corresponding rows XFAIL per known_issues.cfg (see Known Issues table); XPASS on Rev 3 = a feature shipped early, reconcile against the backlog. Acceptance: zero unexpected FAILs; every XFAIL/XPASS reconciled.

Low-Voltage Power Supply (HIL). Verifies FC-EL-5. Objective: confirm the controller operates correctly when powered from each low-voltage supply type: 24 VDC and 24 VAC. Equipment: HIL station; 24 VDC supply; 24 VAC supply. Setup: two discrete supply sources on the HIL (no sweeping). Procedure: (1) power from 24 VDC and run the power-supply verification; (2) power from 24 VAC and run it again. Acceptance: passes only if the verification passes on BOTH supplies.

Overvoltage Protection (Manual + HIL). Verifies FC-EL-15. Objective: verify OVP activates above 40 VDC and the controller recovers automatically. Equipment: manual >40 VDC bench source (operator-provided); HIL quick capability-verification routine. Procedure: (1) raise input >40 VDC, confirm OVP activates; (2) return to normal range, confirm automatic recovery (no manual reset); (3) run HIL quick capability check to confirm survival. Acceptance: OVP activates >40 VDC, auto-resets on return to normal, controller passes post-event verification. Note: overvoltage applied manually; HIL confirms survival.

AI1 / A1_OUTPUT out-of-bounds stress (F.1.4, F.5.1). Stress analog I/O beyond the documented spec range to verify clamp behavior, no permanent damage, and clean recovery to nominal. AI input clamps the resulting speed-modulation output at 0 V and 10 V; commanded A1_OUTPUT clamps at documented limits with no DAC fault. Distinct from FCAT linearity, which sweeps within-spec ranges only.

Propagation-time captures (F.7.1–F.7.3). 4-channel scope + logic analyzer measure end-to-end latency through firmware: Modbus write to AO actuation (F.7.1), coil command to K1 relay transfer (F.7.2), and SPI clock-to-data across the MIB daisy chain (F.7.3). Stimulus on a scope channel + LA capture of the firmware-side GPIO marker. Replaces statistical timing inference with deterministic measurement; critical for closed-loop control-loop integrity.

Speed Command Source & Output (HIL). Verifies FC-SI-1, FC-SI-4, FC-FW-7. Objective: verify the controller delivers the correct 0–10 VDC signal to all motor outputs in both source modes — analog-input passthrough and internally generated (Modbus) — as selected by A1 Output Mode. Equipment: HIL analog output module (apply known voltages to the analog input); analog acquisition module (read all motor outputs); Modbus master (set A1 Output Mode and the output-voltage point). Procedure: (1) Mode = Analog input — apply known voltages, verify every motor output equals each applied voltage; (2) Mode = Modbus — command known output voltages, verify every motor output equals each commanded voltage. Acceptance: motor outputs match expected in all cases, both modes. Architecture note: motors receive only a 0–10 VDC analog signal; the controller supplies it by passing through its analog input or generating it internally (MCU + DAC + conditioning), a relay selecting the source per A1 Output Mode. Input impedance (~100 kΩ) and 40 VDC over-range tolerance are verified at the Main Board DVT (Section A).

Airflow Measurement Accuracy & Analog Output (FCAT). Verifies FC-FW-2, FC-SI-2. Objective: confirm each impeller channel measures airflow within 3% of reading at 25% of that impeller's maximum airflow, and that the 0–10 VDC airflow output tracks calculated airflow (0 V = 0 CFM, 10 V = model maximum) within ±5%. Equipment: FCAT (own pressure/airflow reference); Modbus master; 0–10 VDC read. Setup: install/emulate N motors of the worst-case impeller model on FCAT. Procedure: (1) airflow-accuracy routine — at 25% of each impeller's max, compare controller-reported per-impeller airflow to the FCAT reference, compute per-channel error; (2) airflow-output routine — drive across the range, record 0–10 VDC output vs FCAT reference, compute deviation. Acceptance: |error| ≤ 3% at the 25% point each channel; airflow output linear within ±5% full range. Evidence: FCAT Test Report (Section C).

Status Reporting (FCAT, partial). Verifies FC-FW-8. Objective: verify aggregate status via the alarm relay (fail-open) and individual + aggregate status via Modbus. Equipment: FCAT (per-position motor emulation; alarm-relay output sensing; Modbus master). Procedure: (1) confirm relay contact closed during healthy operation; (2) induce a motor fault, confirm relay contact opens and Modbus reflects both individual and aggregate status. Acceptance: relay closed when healthy, opens on fault; Modbus reflects individual and aggregate status. Note: the de-energization step (relay fails open on loss of controller power) is verified at the Main Board DVT (Section A), not by FCAT. Evidence: FCAT Test Report (Section C).

Blank-off alarm suppression (G.3.3). Known issue: with the blank-off coil ON, the firmware does not currently suppress that fan's alarm — the fan alarm reads True (inverted). XFAIL via known_issues.cfg until the fix lands; XPASS means the fix shipped — reconcile and remove the XFAIL. Distinct from G.2.3 (blank-off exclusion from fault monitoring and airflow count) and G.3.2 (coil-to-DI mirror).

Start/Stop digital input (G.5.1). The Start/Stop DI is in the feature backlog — not implemented in v1.2.0 firmware. Placeholder marked XFAIL via known_issues.cfg. XPASS = feature shipped; reconcile against the backlog and update the pass criteria with the hardware spec (RUN_STATUS transitions, motor stop/start behavior).

Impeller Power Compatibility (Analysis). Verifies FC-EL-1. Objective: confirm by analysis that the controller's input voltage/current capability and component thermal/electrical ratings accommodate the worst-case impeller configurations in the compatibility list. Procedure: (1) identify the two worst-case configs — (A) max input voltage: highest-voltage model (575 VAC) at max supported quantity; (B) max aggregate current: configuration drawing the highest total current; (2) compute aggregate input current per config, compare to controller capacity; (3) compare component thermal/electrical stresses to ratings; (4) verify per-model max quantities do not exceed input-current capacity or available positions. Acceptance: both worst-case configs within capacity and ratings; compatibility-list limits consistent with input capacity and positions.

The design-verification inspection checklist (FC-RE-1, RE-2, RE-3, RE-4, RE-7, RE-8; FC-PH-1, PH-3, PH-4, PH-5; FC-EL-3, EL-14; FC-SI-3; FC-CM-4, CM-7; FC-MF-1) is performed at the Inspection & Mechanical station via visual & dimensional inspection, marking/nameplate checks, and BOM & datasheet review. Each row's criteria column states the requirement to confirm.

FC-MF-2 (unique SN + production data), FC-MF-3 (firmware at build, SemVer, version-controlled), and FC-QA-2 (test records traceable to SN) are verified by production records; FC-MF-4 (per-unit airflow calibration) by production test. Confirmed against production-line records, not at a DVT station.

Capabilities a station must have (✕ = required). Modbus master: FCAT, HIL (HIL also issues deliberate malformed/out-of-range requests). Per-position motor emulation (relay per motor output, OK/fault, up to 9 positions): FCAT, HIL. Alarm-relay output sensing: FCAT, HIL. Analog 0–10 VDC read: FCAT (airflow output), HIL (all motor positions + A1 output). Additel pressure controller (per-motor airflow + reference): FCAT (own unit), HIL (shared lab Additel over Ethernet, manifolded). Generate 0–10 VDC analog stimulus: HIL. Automatic controller power on/off (logic power, motor power retained): HIL. Quick capability-verification routine (functional pass/fail): HIL. Per-channel airflow error computation & pass/fail logging: FCAT. Low-resistance bonding/continuity (≤ 0.1 Ω, 4-wire/Kelvin): FCMT. Hand tools / workbench / User Manual: Inspection & Mechanical. Visual & dimensional inspection, marking/nameplate checks, BOM & datasheet review: Inspection & Mechanical. The first five capabilities are shared between FCAT and HIL.

elaborations.ref: Reference crosswalk (Q-PAC ref ↔ source package ↔ requirement)
elaborations.text: E.1 = low-voltage supply HIL = FC-EL-5; E.2 = full-load current = FC-EL-5; E.3 = overvoltage protection = FC-EL-15; E.4 = protective earthing = FC-EL-6. G.1.1 = speed command source & output = FC-SI-1/SI-4/FW-7; G.1.2 = passthrough on power loss = FC-SI-5; G.2.1 = airflow accuracy & output = FC-FW-2/SI-2; G.2.2 = motor fault status = FC-FW-3; G.2.3 = active vs supported / blank-off = FC-FW-4; G.2.4 = configuration persistence = FC-FW-5; G.2.5 = status reporting = FC-FW-8. Section D HIL Test Report = Modbus server FC-CM-1/CM-3/CM-5/CM-8 + BACnet. H.1 = impeller power compatibility = FC-EL-1; H.2 = ESD = FC-RE-5; H.3 = surge = FC-RE-6. I.1 = removable cover = FC-PH-2. (Source package used DVT-xx case IDs; this document uses the Q-PAC X.Y.Z reference style.)

FC-CM-2 (RS-485 dual ports) is verified at the Main Board DVT (Section A). FC-QA-1 (production functional test) is verified on the production line. Both are Test-method requirements but fall outside the component DVT stations.

Empirical characterization of the controller through real power events, on the HIL station. Background: the Rev 2 cold-start regression passed individual desk testing because the test setup never exercised variable-length power cycles under realistic rail-collapse — exactly the gap this cluster closes. E.5.1–E.5.4 establish baseline rails, input sweep, and power-up-to-first-valid-comms timing. E.5.5–E.5.7 exercise operating brownout (sag during active polling): ride-through, below-threshold reset, and a floor sweep to pin the repeatable ride-through/reset boundary. E.5.8 captures cold-start rail-collapse timing on the scope (reset must assert before any rail drops below the MCU brownout threshold). E.5.9 is the core post-mortem case: 50-cycle sweeps at varied OFF-dwell (full collapse down to minimal discharge) using the HIL power-cycle relay, verifying clean boot, identity, and atmospheric PT at every dwell length. E.5.10/E.5.11 confirm Modbus reconnect and EEPROM persistence across cycles. Equipment: programmable 24 VAC/VDC supply (sag/sweep), HIL power-cycle relay (dwell sweeps), 4-channel scope (rail-collapse). Loaded max-N brownout remains a gap until a programmable electronic load is on the bench; until then the loaded portion uses motor emulation or defers to system level. Maps to PWR / CB / FW change triggers.
